NekoType values your privacy:

1. Local processing: all text reading, transforming and sending happens locally. No network, no upload, no storage of your input.

2. Permission usage:
· Accessibility: only reads the focused input field, applies text replacement and triggers sending; never reads password fields.
· Overlay: shows the floating button.
· Battery optimization: keeps the service running in background.
· Device Admin / Shizuku / Root: optional, only used for system commands after your consent.

3. Third-party: no analytics, ads or tracking SDKs.

4. Revoke: you can revoke any permission anytime in system settings.

5. Contact: TR114512@qq.com

This app rewrites text as you type through the Android accessibility service, for personal study, entertainment and input assistance only.

1. Do not use it for fraud, harassment, rumor-mongering, abuse, impersonation or any illegal activity; all consequences rest solely with the user.
2. Rewriting may fail or not take effect due to system limits, app versions or keyboard differences — do not rely on it for important, sensitive or irreversible communication.
3. Text is processed locally only: no network access, nothing uploaded, no chat content stored (the app does not request the INTERNET permission, so it cannot access the network at system level).
4. This app is not affiliated with WeChat, QQ, Tencent or any third-party app and is not an official product of theirs; trademarks belong to their respective owners.
5. The developer is not liable for any direct or indirect loss caused by using this app.
6. Minors should use it under guardian supervision.
